evidence: On 2026-07-17, `bash run_repro.sh` inspected the Docker Hub metadata for `google/deepvariant:1.6.1` and reported `Image VERSION env: 1.6.0`, with stderr `Mismatch reproduced: google/deepvariant:1.6.1 advertises VERSION=1.6.0`.
steps: Ran `bash run_repro.sh` from the standardized bug folder.
The script fetched the Docker Hub manifest for `google/deepvariant:1.6.1`.
The script fetched the image config blob and extracted `config.Env`.
The config reported `VERSION=1.6.0` instead of the expected `1.6.1`.
The script exited with status 1 to flag the mismatch.
